name: Nakuru County (near Njoro), Kenya
elevationNote: Highlands of the Rift Valley, roughly 2,100–2,300 m above sea level
tagline: Cool highland farms with two rainy seasons
description: The farmland around Njoro in Nakuru County sits high in Kenya's Rift Valley. Temperatures stay cool all year and rain comes in two seasons — the 'long rains' and the 'short rains'.
farmingContext: Maize and beans are important household and market crops in the area.
Many farms grow maize during the long rains; the short rains can support a second, shorter crop.
Cool temperatures at this altitude slow crop growth, so crops take longer than in the lowlands.

seasons.name: Long rains
seasons.description: Main growing season; rain peaks around April.
